tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtsug gtor dri med kyi gzungs klog thabs bzhugs so// mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer kun nas 'phro/ /cho ga sna tshogs nyams dga' ba/ /gzhung bzang pad+mo kha 'byed pa'i/ /dam pa skyes mchog de la 'dud/ /spros kun zhi ba'i thugs rje yis/ /dri med mdo sde'i rgya mtsho las/ /legs par bsrubs pa'i nying khu mchog /gsal bar mdzad pa de la 'dud/ /cho ga'i lag len rim pa rnams/ /gzhung gi dgongs pa ji bzhin du/ /bzang po'i zhabs kyi bka' drin las/ /bdag gis gsal por bri bar bya/ /'phags pa kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs bklag cing mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad dam mchod rten lnga gdab pa'i cho ga'i lag len gyi rim pa la spyi don gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / mjug go /dang po la gnyis te/ mchod rten gdab pa dang / mchod pa bshams pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mchod rten gdab pa'i cho ga btsan pa'i phyag nas mkhan pos btus pa dang / 'di nyid nas bshad pa'i mdo sde bklag pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas ji lta ba bzhin du gdab bo zhes gsungs pas de yang bod yul sogs la sku drin mtshungs zla ma mchis pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bo dhi sa twa'i zhal snga nas kyi lugs 'di la yig cha gnyis gnang ba'i gcig las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'phags pa kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs bklag cing mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad dam mchod rten lnga gdab pa'i cho ga mdo sde las btus pa/ gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gzungs bzlas shing mchod rten gdab pa'i thabs la der gtogs pa thams cad phyi'i khrus kyang bya/ mgo mjug kun tu gnod sems dang / brnab sems dang / ma dad pa dang / le lo dang / gnyid la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i skyon dang / sems ma 'dres par sdom zhing gnod pa dang / 'tshe ba'i las ngan pa ma shor bar bya/

dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan gyi mthu'i khyad par dang / mdo'i phan yon la yid ches pa dang / dad cing gus pa cher bskyed/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang / snying rje cher bskyed do/ /khyim pa zhig yin na bsnyen gnas kyi khrims bzung de nas mchod rten gdab pa'i yo byad rnams bshams la/ 'jim pa brko ba nas gdab cing dkyil 'khor la bzhag pa'i bar du mchod rten gyi cho ga bzhin nangs par snga dro thebs par bya zhes gsungs pas de'i tshul ni/ lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa las/ de la sāts+tsha'i cho ga ni skyon bral rab tu 'jim pa'i sa/ /dri bzang chu'i 'jim pa la/ /rgya 'bur gsal ba'i sāts+tsha ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten no/ /zhes pa gdul gyis gyo mo dang sol ba dang rdo dang gseg ma dang rtswa la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad dang bral ba bkra shis pa'i phyogs nas blangs te tsan+dan la sogs pa'i dri zhim po'i chu blangs te legs par brdungs shing zhes pa 'dres par bya'o/ /de yang / oṃ na mo sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha te bhu mi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bgegs bsal lo/ /lag pa'i sor mo la reg nas/ oṃ na mo sa man+ta bud+dha nāṃ sarba a dhiṣ+ṭha na rat+na bhū mi ye hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes rin po che'i sa gzhir bsam mo/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra kha na kha na hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brko zhing brkos pa thams cad yi ge a'i ngo bor bsam mo/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ a ma la bi ma la nirma le bi shud dhe swāhā/ zhes byang chub sems kyi chu tsan+dan la sogs pa dri zhim pos bran no/ /oṃ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twe bh+yaḥ a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ sarba sa twa bi kalpa ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes rdo rje dbyug pas brdung zhing bsre bar bya'o/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ma badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ zhes 'jim pa'i gong bu gcig tu byas nas/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo oṃ badz+ra pra mar+dha na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas 'jim pa'i gong bu 'di nyid traṃ las rin po che'i ri bor gyur par bsam mo/ /na ma satrai ya dhī kā nāṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puk+ṣ+mai puk+ṣ+mai ya nu ga ta/ shen+te den+te nirku le ya sha ya sho bi ti te dzo ba ti/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di ni sgrib pa rnam sel gyi rgyud las sngags 'di bye ma'am 'jim pa'i gong bu la nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas nas sāts+tsha byas na mchod rten de'i rdul phra rab re re la'ang / mchod rten re rer 'gyur la rdul phra rab de nyid kyi grangs tsam gyi lha dang mi'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /gang du skyes pa de'i skye ba yang dag par 'gyur ro/ /myur du sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad dang mtshungs pa'i sku thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes te 'jim pa'i gong bu de nyid pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho ri rab bye ba'i tshad kyi sku'i ba spu'i gseb thams cad rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa phyogs kyi rigs kyi skus gang bar bsam mo/ /oṃ badz+ra bhe bā dha ye swāhā/ zhes 'jim pa bcad pa'i tshe rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i ba spu'i gseb nas sku re re spyan drangs par bsam mo/ /oṃ rat+no bha ban+te hūm̐ zhes 'bi 'bi byas la sku rin po che'i na bza' lcib mas blangs par bsam zhing / oṃ dharma dhā tu gar+bhe swāhā/ zhes snying po bcug pas thugs bskyed par bsam mo/ /oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze swāhā/ zhes mar gyi snum gyis byug pa ni/ lha'i tshogs kyis dri'i char phab par bsam mo/ /oṃ badz+ra bhe dhe swāhā/ zhes 'jim pa bcad pa'o/ /oṃ dharma ta ror+bha be ya swāhā/ zhes bskos phor du bcug pa'i tshe/ chos 'byung du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /oṃ badz+ra mut+ga ṭa ā ko ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brdung ba'i tshe ming gi yi ge phreng ba du ma dang bcas par bsam zhing sprul pa du ma'i steng du gyur par bsams la/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sam+bho ga kā ya swāhā/ zhes brkos phor nas drangs pa'i tshe longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bsam mo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nirma na kā ya swāhā/ phyung ma thag tu sprul pa'i skur bsam mo/ /oṃ dharma rat+no rat+na saṃ bha be swāhā/ zhes pa'i sku de ba spu'i gseb thams cad skus gang bar bsam mo/ /de yang sku re re pho brang ye shes kyi snying po can mthong na dga' ba'i mchod rten du bzhugs par bsam nas/ oṃ ā yu ṣe swāhā/ zhes srog shing gzugs so/ /oṃ pra mar+dha na ye swāhā/ zhes 'khor lo bzhag nas/ oṃ pa taṃ kā laṃ ba swāhā/ zhes cod pan gdags so/ /oṃ sa ra ra ta swāhā/ zhes pas ba dan dbul lo/ /oṃ kuṃ bhī ra duṃ dh+wa dza min naṃ baṃ swāhā/ zhes chu srin rgyal mtshan dbul lo/ /oṃ pra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes gdugs dbul lo/ /oṃ rat+na mā la traṃ zhes pas phreng ba gdags la/ oṃ na maḥsha yas bug dha pra ti sha ga ti ti bhe/ ta thā ga to adha ro bh+yoḥ saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ su su ye swāhā/ zhes bla bre dbul lo/ /oṃ dharma dā mi li dza le swāhā/ zhes gdan la bzhugs so/ /oṃ badz+ra dhā tu a dhi k+ṣa dhe hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brtan par gsol ba gdab bo/ /de'i 'og tu rten 'brel gyi sngags brjod dri bzang po'i chus bsangs te me tog la sogs pas rgyas par mchod do/ /de nas gzungs gang du gzhugs pa de brjod cing bskor ba gsum mam nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa bya'o/ /sāts+tsha bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /mchod pa'i cho ga yo byad bshams pa yan chad legs par bgyi'o/ /mchod rten 'debs pa'i zla ba la chos kyi sbyin pa dang / 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs dam bskul bar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / gser 'od dam pa dang / rin po che'i tog dang / gtsug na rin po che dang / gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba'i gzungs kyi mdo sde tshar phyin rgyud mi chad par bklag

yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i gzungs rnams gnyis kyi 'dzab gra gcig kyang bzlas/ mdo sde de dag kyang mchod cing chos kyi sbyin par bsngo ba dang / spyan drangs pa la sogs pa sna la bgyis nas bklag go /mdo sde de snyed ma klog na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / gzungs tshar gang byung zhig bton pas 'og tu snying po bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas mchod rten thebs/ mchod pa bshams la chos dar ma rnams rdzogs nas gnas srungs te/ bar skabs su cung zhig gyes nas snga dro dge 'dun spyir tshogs nas mchod pa la sogs rim bzhin bgyi'o/ /mchod pa bshams pa'i thabs 'byor pa'i stobs ci nus dang sbyar te spos kyi maṇ+ḍal chen po'i dbus su tshon phye'i me tog rin po che sna lnga'i phreng rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa bris pa'i dbus su pad+ma chen po'i steng du mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad shong ba'i gdan seng ge'i khri las blangs pa bzhag la re'u mig chen po brgyad dang / ngos bzhi'i dbus su re'u mig gnyis gnyis su bgyis te brgya rtsa brgyad du bshams pa'am/ mchod rten lnga pa zhig na 'tshams sar sbyar te/ de la mchod rten bzhugs su gsol/ ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gcig kyang dbus su bzhugs/ bar gyi snam bu gcig gam gnyis la pad+ma mang po dgram zhing 'phags pa gdan 'dzoms pa'i gdan khri bshams shing gzungs chab kyi bum pa kha rgyan can bzhi yan chad du 'byor pa dngos gzhir bzhag de'i slad rol gar 'os su bshos dang bcas tshon la sogs pa mchod pa rgyas par dgram/ steng du bla bre dang 'phan dang ba dan dmar po brgya rtsa brgyad rgyas par dgram/ grwa bzhir sog phor nas a ka ru dang du ruṣ+ka dang / gu gul gyi bdug pas bdug go /sgo bzhir mchod yon bzhi bshams/ gzhan yang mchod pa ci nus su rgyas par bgyi'o/ /bum pa'i khar yungs kar dang / bye ma yang bzhag cing bzlas la langs nas/

dur khrod dam phyogs kun tu yang gtor/ dang por bgyi ba mchod pa bshams la/ zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don phyag len gyi rim pa ni/ gnyis pa mchod pa bshams pa la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa dang / mchod pa bshams pa dngos so/ /dang po ni gang du dkyil 'khor bri ba'i gzhi legs par 'du byas la/ cha chen bcu drug gi thig gdab pa ni/ spyi dang mthun la/ de la rtsigs pa dang sgo la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i thig rnams kyang dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun no/ /nang na cha chen brgyad yod pa bcu drug tu btang ste/ de la bar gyi snam bu gnyis pa byed na dbus nas bgrang ba'i brgyad pa dang bdun pa gnyis lha snam dang / drug pa la pad+ma bya'o/ /lhag ma la re'u mig brgyad yod pa'i ngos bzhir dbus nas bgrangs pa'i cha chen gsum pa'i tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yon gyi re'u mig gnyis po la/ re'u mig gnyis gnyis su bgyis te/ re'u mig brgya rtsa brgyad du bgyis pa ni/ mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhugs pa'i an de gdan yin la/ de 'degs pa'i seṅge'i khri ni/ gdan gyi 'og na yod bsam pa las gzhan med do/ /bar gyi snam bu gcig par byed na/ dbus nas bgrang ba'i cha chen brgyad pa lha snam dang / bdun pa pad+ma dang / drug pa an 'degs pa'i seṅge'i khri bya'o/ /gzhan re mig rnams ni sngar bzhin no/ /de ni mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad byed pa'i lugs yin no/ /mchod rten lnga pa ltar na lha snam la sogs pa ni sngar dang 'dra la/ dbus su cha chen gcig zlum por bskor/ ngos bzhir cha chen gsum pa dang / bzhi pa'i bar gyi thig dang / tshangs thig phrad mtshams nas cha chen gcig gis zlum por bskor te/ de rnams la pad+ma 'dab brgyad re re byas na yong ba 'dra'o/ /yang na lha snam gcig dang gnyis pa gang byed pa sngar bzhin byas la/ lha snam gyi nang yan chad la pad+ma 'dab brgyad chen po gcig byas te/

de'i steng du rdo gru bzhi pa 'jam po'am/ shing gru bzhi pa 'jam po la sngar ltar/ re mig brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad lnga pa bgyis te bzhag la der mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad dam mchod rten lnga bzhugs su gsol na rung bar mngon te/ cho ga 'di nyid las rat+na lnga'i pho brang rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa bris pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma chen po'i steng du mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad shongs pa'i an seṅge'i khri la blangs pa bzhag la zhes dang / mchod rten gdab pa'i cho gar/ mchod rten bzhag pa'i dkyil 'khor ni stegs bur rtsig pa dang / rdo gor mo dang shing bu las dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bgyis pa gang yang rung ste zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gang ltar yang bar gyi snam bu rnams la tshon phye'am chu tshon gyis pad+ma dmar po bya'o/ /gang gi re mig brgya rtsa brgyad la/ mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhugs su gsol la ring bsrel bcas pa'i mchod rten gcig kyang dbus su bzhugs zhes pa ni/ dbus kyi mchod rten bzhi'i bar du mañdzi la sogs pa'i steng du 'jog pa las med do/ /gnyis pa mchod pa bsham pa dngos ni/ bar gyi dkyil 'khor lha snam la shongs na/ lha snam phyi ma'i sgo'i phyogs la nye bar gzungs chab kyis bum pa kha rgyan can bzhi bzhag de'i g.yas g.yon rtsigs pa dang nye ba na phar mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas phyogs rer tshar re/ grwa bzhir/ a ka ru dang du ru ka dang / tsan+dan dang gu gul la sogs pa'i bdug spos bshams/ sgo bzhir mchod yon bzhi bshams/ dkyil 'khor du mi shongs na dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du bum pa la sogs pa khor yug tu bshams mo/ /steng du bla bre dang / 'phan dang / ba dan dmar po brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa yang rgyas par bsham mo/ /bum pa'i khar yungs kar dang bye ma yang snod gtsang mar bzhag go /gzhan yang zlum gtor phyogs skyong thun mong du gcig

rgyal chen bzhi la re re bsham/ sbyor ba'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ dge 'dun tshogs nas phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa thams cad la phyag bgyi/ zhes gsungs pas/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes sogs rgyun bzhin nyer gcig de nas chos thams cad dmigs su med pa'i stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ci nus su bsgom/ de nas ting nge 'dzin las langs nas chos thams cad don dam pa de lta bu yin la/ 'phags pa rnams kyi de kho na nyid thugs su chud pas sku dang gsung thugs nam mkha' dang 'dra bar 'gyur te/ sgrib pa mi mnga' zhing mthu dang byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i go 'phang brnyes par ma rung na/ kye ma'o sems can 'di dag ni chos kyi de kho na nyid ma rtogs te rmongs pa nyon mongs pa sdug bsngal mang pos gzigs cing nyam thag pa'i gnas su lhung bar 'gyur la/ sems can thams cad kyang 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ 'gro ba brgyud pa rnams su bdag gi gnyen bshes dam pa drin gyi zhing du ma gyur pa 'ga' yang med cing / bdag gis kyang dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ 'gro ba mang po'i don dpag tu med pa bsgrub par dam bcas pa'i tshe sems can thams cad bdag gis blang zin pas/ 'di lta bu la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yal bar 'dor ba ni shin tu mi rigs na/ 'di dag ji ltar sdug bsngal las ni gdon/ bde ba la ni 'god par bya snyam du snying rje dang / byams pa chen po dang ldan pa'i brtson pa'i sems drag tu bskyed par bya'o/ /yang 'di snyam du bsam ste/ bdag ni dus ngan pa'i sems can spyod pa dang mthu dman pa yin pas/ bdag nyid gcig pus 'phral du don rlabs po che 'di lta bu mi lcogs kyis ston pa bde bar gshegs pas sngon lha'i bu nor bu'i snying po dri ma med pa'i rjes su thugs brtse bas gsungs pa kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang snying po la rnam par blta ba'i gzungs la brten te/

phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa dang / dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzoms par spyan drangs la/ mthu bstan pa dang dpung gnyen du gsol te/ da lta ni 'phags pa'i mthu dang byin gyi rlabs kyis 'gro ba thams cad la phan pa sgrub par byas la phyis ni bdag nyid gcig pu gzhan la ltos pa med par thabs mkhas pa'i sgo sna tshogs nas/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa yang dag pa bsgrub par bya'o snyam du bsam mo/ /de ltar snying rje dang byams pa'i sems bskyed pa'i 'og tu sems can gyi don nyid bya ba'i phyir 'phags pa gdan 'dzoms pa'i pho brang dang / mchod pa bshams la bden pa bdar zhing yid kyis bsngo ste/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis deng kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par blta ba'i gzungs kyi mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad gdab pa'i gnas 'dir/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa dang / 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzoms pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor dang / mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba 'di rnams ji ltar sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can gyis bsgrub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan dang ldan par gyur te/ sa gzhi rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam zhing tha gru che ba/ yangs pa reg na 'jam zhing bde ba dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/

tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i dri bsung dang ldan pa lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyis gcal du bkram pa/ mtha' rin po che'i pha gus rtsigs shing / gser dang mu tig gi bye ma gram bur brdal ba/ ut+pa la ku mu ta dang pad+ma 'gying zhing ldem pas khebs par gyur te/ chu bya sna tshogs sgra snyan sgrogs/ dga' zhing 'phyo la lding bas brgyan pa'i yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho dang rdzing dang lteng ka dag gis mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa dang / lha'i nor bu dang / mu tig gi rgyan phreng dang / rin po che dpyangs pa/ me tog gi mgo lcog dang / 'bras bu mdzes par chags pas g.yur za zhing ldem la gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba las dam pa'i chos kyi sgra 'byung ba dang ldan pa tshar du sbrengs pas legs par brgyan pa'i sa gzhi la gzhal med khang chen po sna bdun 'bar ba mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med par rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen po rab tu 'byung ba/ gnas tha dad pa shin tu rnam par phye ba mtha' yas pa rnam par gnas pa rgya yongs su ma chad pa/ khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul 'jig rten las 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyu las byung ba shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang bsgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i dge 'dun dang ldan pa/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa mtha' yas pa rnam par rgyu ba/ chos kyi ro'i dga' ba dang / bde ba chen pos bstan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad yang dag par thob par byed pa nye bar gnas pa/ nyon mongs pa'i dri ma'i gnod pa thams cad dang bral ba bdud thams cad yongs su spangs pa/ thams cad kyi bkod pa las lhag pa/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa'i gnas dran pa dang / blo gros dang rtogs pa chen pos nges par 'byung ba zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong chen po'i bzhon pa yin pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa nas 'jug pa/ rin po che'i pad+ma'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i bkod pa la brten pa'i gzhal med khang chen por gyur pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i gdan/ rin po che'i seṅge'i khri steng na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sku'i mchod rten/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa rgya dang tshad dpag tu med pa mchod rten gyi rnam pa'i bye brag dang / legs pa'i khyad par thams cad dang ldan pa/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan thams cad kyi bdag nyid/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi dpal zhing du gyur pa/ grangs med pa zhig rol mor dkrigs par gyur pa'i mtha' 'khor bar gzhal med khang chen po'i nang du/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzoms pa gdan khri 'phags pa so so'i smon lam khyad par can gyi mnga' thang dang 'tsham par grub pa mdzes pa sha stag 'byung bar gyur cig phyi nang kun tu yang cha rigs dang 'tsham bar lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang / de nas ting shag sil snyan rnga dung dang bcas pa'i khongs su rol mo la sogs pa/ phul du phyin pa sna tshogs pa/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang / bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las 'byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klub pa dang ldan par gyur cig 'phags pa thams cad kyang gdan 'dzoms nas de bzhin du byin gyis brlabs shing bzhes te longs spyod par gyur cig ces brjod nas ting shag sogs sgra bcag kyang phyi nang kun tu sogs gong bzhin/ lan gnyis te/

lan gsum bzlas yang dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de bzhin du gyur cig ces lan gsum du bzlas/ mchod pa'i tshogs bden pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'og tu 'phags pa spyan drangs te/ pus mo btsugs te me tog blangs thal mo sbyar nas tshig 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu na dus gsum bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dgongs su gsol/ thugs rje chen po dang byin gyi rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' zhing / 'gro ba'i don du smon lam khyad par can mdzad pa las gleng ste/ che ge mo bdag cag la sogs pa zhes 'og ma kun la sbyar la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du mgon skyabs su gsol nas/ spyan 'dren ci mchis na mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzoms pa chen po mdzad de/ byin gyis brlabs pa ci gnang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rje dang rgyal po chen po yul 'khor skyong dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / ku be ra dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dga' ldan pa'i lha'i sras rnams dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i sras rnams dang / lha'i bu nor bu'i snying po dri ma med pa la sogs pa/ kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par blta ba'i gzungs lhag par phyag mtshan du bzhes pa rnams dang / gzhan yang sngon gdan 'dzoms pa chen po'i bkas gtad cing so sor nas kyang lha'i ngag brtags pas zhal gyis bzhes te dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnam bzhi bsrung zhing bskyang bar thugs dam mnga' ba'i 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad sngon gyi thugs dam bzang po dang /

mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba las glengs te che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du/ mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren du mchis na/ mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzoms pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlabs pa ci gnang / spyan drangs pa'i rjes la gong du bshams pa lta bu'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor du/ 'phags pa'i tshogs phyogs bcu nas gshegs te/ 'khor dang bcas pa gdan la bzhugs par yid kyis bsam zhing / mngon du dmigs la 'greng phyag bdun man chad bgyi zhes gsungs pas/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa la sogs pa shar phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan bdun phyag 'tshal dang bcas pa/ de bzhin du phyag brjod lan bdun re byed pa rigs 'gre'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i tog la sogs pa lho phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa la sogs pa nub phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rnga sgra la sogs pa byang phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa 'og gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi 'od zer la sogs pa steng gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/

/skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal la sogs pa byang shar mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dam pa'i dpal la sogs pa shar lho'i mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mchog gi dpal la sogs pa lho nub mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gdugs dam pa la sogs pa nub byang mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa gdul bya'i dbang du 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par rol pa sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing bzhugs pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de dag la sogs pa phyogs bcu na dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dkon mchog bla na med pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis legs par gsungs pa legs par bsgrubs pa legs par thugs su chud pa dam pa'i chos dkon mchog bla na med pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi thugs kyi sras/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa chen po la rab tu gnas la gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin rab tu brnyes pa/ mtshan ma med pa'i spyod yul can/ chos thams cad la mnyam pa nyid kyi bzod pa dang ldan pa/ spobs pa thogs pa med pa/ mngon par shes pa chen pos rol pa chos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa/ gzhan gyi don la rab tu brtson pa/ sa bcu dang rigs lngas bsdus pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog bla na med pa/ thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyi gsung gi sras rig pa bzhugs pa lam yang dag pa nyid la gnas pa nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang du gyur pa/ zhi ba/ dul ba/ gtsang ba/ bsangs ba/ rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ rang gi don rab tu thob pa/ 'phags pa rang rgyal ba dang / 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dkon mchog bla na med pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /phyogs bcu na mchod rten ring bsrel dang / sku gdung dang bcas pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / ku bai ra dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / dga' ldan rnams kyi lha'i sras rnams dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i ris kyi lha'i sras rnams dang / lha'i bu nor bu'i snying po dri ma med pa la sogs pa 'phags pa kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par blta ba'i gzungs dang / de la brten pa'i gang zag rnams bsrung zhing bskyab par lhag par phyag mtshan du bzhes pa rnams dang / gzhan yang sngon gdan 'dzoms pa chen po'i bkas btad cing / so so nas kyang lha'i ngag brtags pas zhal gyis bzhes te/

dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnam bzhi bsrung zhing bskyab par thugs dam mnga' ba/ 'phags pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de nas gong du bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams la dmigs nas/ 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad la mchod yon dang / dri chab/ me tog dang / bdug spos/ zhal zas dang mar me/ rol mo dang sil snyan/ gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa/ dngos su ci 'byor pa 'di dag dang / phyogs bcu na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i rdzas dang / lha dang mi'i bde ba longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa ci mchis pa thams cad dang / gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang / mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa chos kyi dbyings su gtogs pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste/ mchod cing dbul lo/ /zhes dang / yang ting shag sogs gong bzhin dkrol 'bul byas la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sa ra pra mar+dha ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+ra badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dzo badz+re/ ma hā bid+ya badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi man+t+ro pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ne badz+re swāhā/ zhes brjod la ting shag sogs sgra bcag langs phyag dang bcas/ ji snyed su dag nas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod bar phyag me tog dam pa sogs nas/ mchod par bgyi la ting shag sogs dkrol 'bud dang bcas/ na bza' nas mchod par bgyi bar ting shag sogs bzhag tsog pur 'dug nas/ 'dod chags sogs bsngo'o phyag gcig byas nas gral la 'dug ting shag dkrol la/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i nas/ dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bar brjod/ de nas gtor ma lnga po de/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ thal mo khong stong g.yo ba dang bcas pa'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas oṃ in+d+ra ye sogs/ cha gsum nas 'byung ba ltar dang / oṃ dh+ri ta raṣ+ṭa ya sogs rgyal chen bzhi la dbul/ yang na phyogs skyong rgyal chen thams cad la/ oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis bsngo ba'ang gsungs so/ /de'i rjes la 'phags pa rnams la phrin las mdzad par smon lam gdab pa ni/ 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnams dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rjes su 'jug cing slob ste srid pa'i rgya mtshor sdug bsngal mang pos nyen pa'i 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba las bsgral zhing bla na ma mchis pa'i bde ba la dgod par yang dag par dam bcas nas/ deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs kyi mchog gis brgyan pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor bshams te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dang / dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i thugs dam mnga' ba thams cad gdan 'dzoms par spyan drangs nas/ kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par blta ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs bklags shing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad tshul bzhin du btab cing mchod/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / 'dus pa chen po rin po che'i tog dang / gtsug na rin po che'i tog la sogs pa ste/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dang / gsung rab zab cing rgya che ba bklag cing mchod de/ gdan 'dzoms pa chen po'i gleng gzhir gsol nas che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i gnod pa dang sdug bsngal ba thams cad zhi bar bgyi ba dang / phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa thob par bgyi ba'i don chen por sgrub pa'i mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du gsol zhing mchis nas 'phags pa'i mthu dpal dang /

thugs rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba rnams kyis sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang / thugs dam bzang po'i dbang du mdzad do/ /phongs shing nyam thag pa'i sems can skyabs su gsol ba rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ bdag cag dge 'dun skye bo rnams kyis theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dang / gzungs dang zab pa dang rgya che ba rnams bklags shing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i mchod rten bgyi ba'i cho ga gzugs brnyan tsam zhig bgyid pa 'di gleng gzhir mdzad nas/ mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gdan 'dzoms pa chen por mdzad de/ mchod pa bzhes shing ji ltar sngon cho ga gang tshul gang gis byin gyis brlabs te mdzad pa bzhin du/ deng yang cho ga yongs su rdzogs par mdzad de/ byin gyis brlabs shing chos kyi de kho na nyid gtan la dbab pa la sogs te/ thabs mkhas pa'i sgo sna tshogs nas/ 'phags pa thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa'i sgo yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang / che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang gnod pa thams cad rgyu dang bcas pa byang zhing zhi ba dang / phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa 'phral du thob par 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs shing ji ltar 'tshal ba yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal bar ci gnang / sngon lha'i bu nor bu'i snying po dri ma med pa la rjes su thugs brtse nas/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi dpal gyi mgur nas/ ji skad du/ lha'i dbang po kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par blta ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs sngags zungs shig phyag rgya 'di ni gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsung zhing rjes su yi rangs pa'o/ /gzungs sngags 'di thos pa dang mthong ba tsam gyis sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang /

sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi sgrib pa rnam par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba thams cad 'jig par 'gyur te/ dper na me yis rtswa bsregs pa/ /rlung gis thal ba myur du dengs/ /de bzhin tshe rabs snga ma la/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad sreg /dper na char pa 'bab gyur te/ /ri las 'bab pa'i 'bab chu yis/ /sa yi steng gi phyags dar dang / /nyal nyil thams cad dengs par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzungs 'di mthong ba dang / /thos pa tsam gyis sdig pa 'byongs/ /dper na me yis gser sbyangs pa/ /sos bcad rung ba snyi bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin bzlas brjod byas tsam gyis/ /lus sbyongs 'gyur te the tshom med/ /dper na nyi ma shar gyur na/ /'od zer kun tu rab tu 'byung / /de bzhin su zhig gzungs 'chang ba/ /de yi lus kyang rnam par mdzes/ /dper na skam sar nya 'dre ldog /chu dang bral bas 'chi sgor 'gro/ /la las slar yang chu rnyed na/ /de na gnas shing rtse ba'o/ /de bzhin dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /mi rnams tshe ni bzlog par byed/ /gzungs 'di bris la mchod rten gsar pa'am rnying pa bcos pa gang yang rung ste de'i nang du gzhug go /spos kyi dkyil 'khor byas te me tog gis gtor/ a ga ru dang du ruṣ+ka'i bdug pas bdug ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa byas/ mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad gdab bo/ /snying po 'di bris te mchod rten gyi nang du bcug na/ gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bye ma snyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gdung gi ring bsrel mchod rten re'i nang du bcug par 'gyur ro/ /'di la gus par byas te mchod rten gyi las byas na/ tshe zad pa las tshe slar nur te tshe ring por skyong bar byed do/ /gal te shi 'phos na yang sbrul gyi pags pa brjes pa bzhin du/

lus bor nas bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar mi 'gyur/ ngan 'gro skye bar mi 'gyur/ phyin chad sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sgra rna lam du yang grags par mi 'gyur na/ 'bras bu rnam par smin par 'gyur ba lta ci smos te de ni gnas med do/ /nad kyis btab pa dang / gnod pa dang / tshe zad pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang / rgyal po dang pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis 'jigs shing skrag pa dang / bu 'dod pas dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs par bzhag go /rma bya'i sgro lngas byabs par bya'i/ cho ga 'di lan gcig byas na bskal pa 'bum du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad dang / ngan song thams cad dang / 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sdug bsngal dang / sgrib pa dang / sdig pa dang / gdug pa thams cad rnam par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /yun ring du nad kyis bsnyungs te/ sha zad pa yang lus yongs su rdzogs shing dag par 'gyur ro/ /bsam pa yang yid bzhin du rdzogs par 'gyur te/ de dang gang dag gtam byas pa de dag thams cad kyang sdig pa dag las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba rnams la smos na yang dud 'gro'i skye gnas thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /tha na khyi dang / rus sbal dang / sbrul dang / sre mo dang / srog chags sna tshogs la smras na yang / thams cad yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /bye ma la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ dur khrod du gtor na gang gi rus pa la phog pa de dag sems can dmyal bar skyes pa nas yongs su thar te/ mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag mtho ris su skyes pa de dag gi lus la me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gcan gzan dang bya'i tshogs dang dur khrod pa de dag thams cad kyang bde 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur ro/

/ri la gtor na ri dwags dang bya rgyu ba de dag thams cad bde 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod 'bum byas na gal te mgul na thag pas btags te 'khrid na yang gshin rje'i gnas nas 'phral du ldog par 'gyur ro/ /tshe'i 'jigs pa chen po las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba thams cad kyang rnam par 'jig ste the tshom med do/ /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje yang bran bzhin du sems shing 'dug go /lpags pa'i mdog gser gyi kha dog lta bur 'gyur ro/ /nges par 'phral du phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /sa bcu la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /lung bstan pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /tha na grib mas phog pa yang yongs su grol bar 'gyur na bya ba mang du byed pa lta ci smos te/ de'i phan yon dpag tu med do zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa phan yon dpag tu ma mchis pa ji skad du gsungs pa thams cad che ge mo la sogs pas 'phral du thob cing mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs par ci gnang / gzungs 'di nyid phyag mtshan du bzhes pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / dga' ldan pa'i lha'i sras thams cad dang / brgya byin lha'i dbang po la sogs pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i rigs kyi lha'i bu thams cad dang / lha'i bu nor bu'i snying po dri ma med pa la sogs pas 'di skad du gzungs sngags mthu chen po 'di ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bur mthong ba dang / thos par dka' ba lags te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag lhan cig phyogs nas slad ma'i dus na/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'di gzung bar bgyi'o/ /'di rgyas par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad la bsgrag par bgyi'o/ /'di 'dzin pa'i sems can chen po de'i slad bzhin 'brang zhing / rtag tu rgyun mi chad par bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang sba bar bgyi'o/

/bu bzhin du yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o zhes gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang grogs po dag legs so/ /khyed kyis kyang de ltar gyis shig rig sngags kyi rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'di ngas khyed la gtad do/ /zhes rjes su gnang ba mdzad pa rnams dang / gzhan yang 'phags pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad kyis kyang / bdag cag dus ngan pa'i gang zag bsam pa dang / spyod pa dman zhing cho ga tshul bzhin rngo mi thogs pa'i dbang du mi bgyi bar/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' lung tshad mar bsgrubs pa dang / so so'i thugs dam rlabs po che yongs su bskang bar gtso bor dgongs shing / dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / gzungs rnams kyi mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang du mdzad de gdan 'dzom pas mdo sde dang / gzungs kyi cho ga thams cad yongs su rdzogs par srungs shing / phan yon ji ltar bka' stsal pa thams cad che ge mo la sogs pa thams cad 'phral du thob par byin gyis brlabs par ci gnang / ci nas kyang dkon mchog gsum sku mi ngas pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa bdag cag skye bo'i dge 'dun rnams kyang ngag mi sun/ 'jig rten gyis smad par mi 'gyur ba'i tshul du mthu dang phan yon sngon du bstan par ci gnang / zhes pa'i bar tshar gcig bklag de'i 'og tu ji ltar gsol ba bzhin du 'phags pa rnams kyis phrin las mdzad cing 'gro ba'i don du 'gyur bar bden pa bdar zhing / yid kyis bsngos te/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mthu dang byin gyis brlabs pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang / 'phags pa sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi spyod pa ma dag pa mi mnga' ba rnams kyi thugs dam nges pa'i bden pas/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i tshul bzhin du/

chos kyi sku'i mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad btab ste/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos brgyan pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor bshams pa 'dir/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa dang / chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de/ mchod pa bzhes shing / kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba'i gzungs dang / chos kyi sku'i mchod rten rnams tshul bzhin byin gyis brlabs par mdzad de/ mdo sde gzungs zab cing rgya che ba rnams so so'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par bskang ste che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i don dpag tu med par mdzad par gyur cig chos kyi sku'i mchod rten la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rig pa'i rgyal mo'i yig 'bru gser gyi mdog can phreng bar gnas pa dang / 'phags pa rnams kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pas/ 'jig rten thams cad du khyab cing / 'phags pa rnams kyi sku la bab pas ni sgrib pa gnyis las grol zhing thar pa gong nas gong du 'phar te/ 'gro ba'i don spyad pa'i mthu dpag tu med pa thob cing / sems can gyi don la bskul bar gyur cig 'gro ba lnga'i sems can thams cad kyi lus la phog pas de dag thams cad so so'i sdug bsngal dang / sgrib pa thams cad 'phral du zhi zhing bde ba dang ldan par gyur la 'od zer gyi phung po'i nang na/ 'phags pa gdan 'dzom pa mthong nas/ bka' drin gzo dad pa skyes nas skyabs su mchi zhing / byang chub tu sems bskyed nas ngan song gi gnas nas thar te/ 'phags pa'i lam la 'jug par gyur cig bdag cag dge 'dun rnams la khyab nas bdag cag kyang 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa sgrub nus pa'i mthu thogs pa med pa thob ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dag dang sku dang gsung dang thugs mtshungs par gyur cig yang 'od zer de dag gcig tu 'dus pas bum pa'i gzungs khyab la khyab ste reg pa tsam gyis gnod pa bkra mi shis pa dang /

mi bde ba thams cad zhi bar byed pa/ dpal dang bde legs skyed par byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i dag byed du gyur cig che ge mo'i lus dang 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad du khyab ste/ nad dang / bkra mi shis pa dang / gnod pa thams cad bsal zhing zhi nas lus dang sems dri ma dang skyon thams cad dang bral te/ rdo rje lta bur mkhregs shing brtan pa dang / chos kyi snod du rung bar gyur cig gzhan yang chos kyi de kho na nyid gtan la dbab pa la sogs pa thabs mkhas pa'i sgo sna tshogs nas/ 'phags pa thams cad 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don rdzogs par gyur cig bdag dge 'dun gyis sems kyi dmigs pa 'ga' bskyed pa dang / gzungs kyi tshig 'bru 'ga' brjod pa yang 'phags pa rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sna tshogs dang / tshig 'bru mtha' yas pas rdzogs shing rnam par dag par byin gyis brlabs par gyur cig ces lan gsum bzlas/ de'i 'og tu ji ltar gsol ba bzhin du 'phags pa rnams kyis phrin las mdzad cing 'gro ba'i don du 'gyur ba bden pa bdar zhing / yid kyis bsngos te/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mthu dang byin gyi rlabs dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang / 'phags pa sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi kun tu spyod pa ma dag pa mi mnga' ba rnams kyi thugs dam nges pa'i bden pas de bzhin du gyur cig ces lan gsum bzlas/ 'phags pa rnams kyi dgongs pa bskul zhing / gleng gzhir gyur pa'i gzungs kyi mdo tshar phyin gcig dang zla la bklag ces pa ni/ dge 'dun rnams cho ga la 'jug pa dang mnyam du gzungs kyi mdo sde klog mkhan gcig dang / zur du 'jog pa yin pa 'dra'o/ /de'i 'og tu 'phags pa rnams kyis gnang zhing phrin las mdzad par nges par yid ches par bskyed/ ji ltar bden pas bsngos pa bzhin du mngon sum du dmigs shing bsam/

de nas 'od zer 'phros pas nad pa'am yon bdag gang rung dang gzungs chab dag la khyab par mngon du dmigs bzhin du/ cho ga mkhan po thams cad kyis gzungs kyi mdo/ rgya gar skad du/ sa man+ta mu kha zhes pa nas rnam par blta ba'i gzungs rdzogs so zhes pa'i bar gtsug tor dri med kyi mdo bklag na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ oṃ ma hā tsin+da ma ṇi dz+wa la na zhes pa nas dhiṣ+ṭha te swāhā bar dang / oṃ na maḥsatrai ya dhi kā naṃ zhes pa nas saṃ dza swā hā bar so so nas brgya rtsa brgyad kun gyis bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas sbyin bdag la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'phags pa'i tshogs la mngon du phyogs par bzhag la rma bya'i sgro lngas byab bo/ /de nas yon bdag la sogs pas phyogs bzhi nas mchod nas/ byang chub tu sems bskyed cing smon lam 'debs su stsal te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / dam pa'i chos dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang / rang rgyal ba'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa dkon mchog bla na med pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu na mchod rten sku gdung dang / ring bsrel dang bcas pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / ku be ra dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / dga' ldan gnas kyi lha'i sras thams cad dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i ris kyi lha'i sras rnams dang / lha'i bu nor bu'i snying po dri ma med pa la sogs pa/ 'phags pa kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dam tshig la rnam par blta ba'i gzungs dang / de la brten pa'i gang zag rnam bzhi bsrung zhing bskyang bar lhag par phyag mtshan du bzhes pa rnams dang /

gzhan yang sngon gdan 'dzoms pa chen pos bka'i gtad cing so so nas kyang / lha'i ngag brtags pas zhal gyis bzhes te/ dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnam bzhi bsrung zhing bskyang bar thugs dam mnga' ba/ 'phags pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag byed du bcug de nas gdan la bzhag la 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang dri chab/ bdug spos dang me tog zhal zas dang mar me/ rol mo dang sil snyan/ gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa dngos su ci 'byor pa 'di dag dang / phyogs bcu na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i lha rdzas dang / mi'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ci mchis pa thams cad dang / gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang / mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i chos kyi dbyings su gtogs pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste dbul zhing mchod do/ /de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas mchod/ 'phags pa thams cad dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba thog ma ma mchis pa nas/ 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe lus dang ngag dang yid kyis sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang / pha ma dang / sems can gzhan dag la sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba ci mchis pa de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdom zhing bsdus te sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar bla na med pa'i so sor bshags pas 'chags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /slan chad kyang 'di lta bu mi bgyid do/ /de ltar lan gsum du'o/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bsod nams kyi rjes su yi rang ba bla na med pa thugs su chud pa/ de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang /

rang rgyal ba dang / 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad dang / 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /de ltar lan gsum du'o/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas sangs rgyas kyi gdung mi bcad par bgyi ba'i slad du dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba skyes bu chen po khyu mchog sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bla na med pa'i chos kyi sku mnga' ba la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ bla na med pa de bzhin gshegs pa la mnga' ba zhi ba chos kyi sku so sor rang gi rig pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun dul ba tshogs kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ phyogs bzhi pa'i 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de ltar lan gsum du'o/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi bar du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dus ji lta ba dad stobs ci mchis pa bzhin du bdag 'bul zhing mchis na/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa dag bdag bzhes su gsol/ de ltar lan gsum du'o/ /phyogs bcu'i ston pa bla na med pa sangs rgyas thams cad la 'gro ba mang po la phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du/ chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo/ /de ltar lan gsum du'o/ /'jig rten gyi sgron ma mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ston par bzhed pa rnams la 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad cing thams cad 'jig rten na gtan du bzhugs par gsol bar 'tshal lo/ /de ltar lan gsum du'o/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/

sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang / sems can thams cad dgrol ba dang / sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'god pa'i slad du/ ji ltar bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ nam snying po byang chub la gnas kyi bar du/ sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang / sems can thams cad dgrol ba dang / sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'god pa'i slad du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dang / gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyis rang gi sems gzod ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub kyi snying po la gnas kyi bar du byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis/ bdud dpung dang bcas pa de dag pham pa mdzad nas/ de nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang bdud dpung dang bcas pa mtha' dag pham par bgyis te/ bdag nyid mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar sngon de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis nyid mngon par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar bgyi'o/

/ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yag dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas tshogs yongs su bsdus pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te tshogs yongs su bsdus par bgyi'o/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /de ltar lan gsum du'o/ /bdag gis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang / gzhan yang bdag gis bsod nams cung zad ci bgyis pa dang / bgyid pa dang bgyi bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad pha ma la sogs pa sems can thams cad dang / bdag gi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o/ /bdag gi bsod nams 'dis pha ma la sogs pa sems can ma bsgral ba rnams ni bsgral lo/ /ma grol ba rnams ni dgrol lo/ /sems can dbugs ma phyin pa rnams ni dbugs dbyung ngo / /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'da' ba rnams ni yongs su mya ngan las bzla'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas pa ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bgyi'o/ /skyabs ma mchis pa dang / gnas ma mchis pa dang / dpung gnyen ma mchis pa'i 'jig rten la skyabs dang / gnas dang / dpung gnyen du gyur cig bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas/ /rga na 'chi ba'i rlabs chen 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par bgyi/ /des na bdag sbyin pa rtsom pa dang / tshul khrims srung ba dang / bzod pa sgom pa dang / brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang / bsam gtan la mnyam par 'jog pa dang / shes rab rnam par dpyod pa dang / thabs mkhas pa la slob pa ci yang rung ste/ de thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du/

bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las brtsams te/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa/ sa chen po la gnas pa rnams kyi rjes su mthun par 'jug go /'phags pa dag bdag byang chub sems dpar legs par gzung du gsol/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /rtsi dang nags kyi shing lta bur/ /rtag tu srog chags thams cad kyis/ /'dod dgur rtag tu spyod par shog /mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang / /thos pa dang ni dran pas kyang / /bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ /nad rnams gso bar bgyid gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro dag ni rtag tu stong par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa/ /de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig /de ltar lan gsum du'o/ /de ltar bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / mchod pa dang / byang chub kyi sems dam pa bskyed pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams dang / dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa nas bsgrags shing chos kyi sku'i mchod rten tshul bzhin bgyis te mchod pa la sogs pa dge ba rlabs po che dag gi stobs kyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad bdag dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa mthar phyin par mdzad pa'i dgongs pa lhun gyis grub par gyur cig pho brang gi dkyil 'khor thams cad du bzang po spyod pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rgyas pas bklub par gyur cig dam pa'i chos rnam pa thams cad kyi sgo nas 'jig rten thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur te/ yi ge bris pa dang / mchod pa dang / bklags pa dang / 'don pa dang / sbyin pa dang / 'chad pa dang / nyan pa dang / bsam pa dang / bsgoms pa/ mngon du byed pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba thams cad kyi rgyud la gnas par gyur cig byang chub sems dpa' thams cad so so'i rnam par thar pa yongs su rdzogs shing /

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa rnams su thogs pa med par 'jug cing / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod cing / bka' lung yang dag par sgrub pa dang / sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba la yo byad kyis kyang bzung zhing thabs mkhas pa dang / mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang du 'byor par gyur cig 'phags pa rang rgyal dang nyan thos thams cad so so'i rnam par thar pa phyin nas theg pa bla na med pa'i sgor gzhol zhing bsgrubs te/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig 'phags pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad rang gi 'khor yongs su smin par mdzad pa dang / phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad pa'i mthu dpal dang / thabs mkhas pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing thugs dam rlabs po che thams cad yongs su bskang ba dang lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang thob pa dang / so so'i rnam par thar pa myur du rdzogs shing chos kyi mnga' bdag chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig che ge mo pha spun 'khor dang bcas pa la g.yo med par lhag par bsgo zhing phan 'dogs pa'i lha mgon thams cad lus dang sems kyi rgyud kyi sdig pa dang / nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dang bral te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang / legs pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig dkon mchog bla na med pa gsum po la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing / byang chub kyi sems dam pa bskyed pa yongs su rdzogs par bsgrubs nas/ rim gyis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig rang gi 'khor skyong ba dang / phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa la mthu dang / thabs mkhas pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig mu med mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi yang sgrib pa thams cad ni byang /

sdug bsngal dang gnod pa thams cad ni zhi/ byang chub kyi phyogs la sogs pa dge ba'i chos thams cad ni yongs su rdzogs te/ 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad spangs nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs pa/ g.yung drung gi sku myur du thob par gyur cig de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabs po che thams cad ma lus par 'phags pa thams cad la phul ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad la bstabs shing bsngos pa la sogs pa/ che ge mos thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas 'phags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa'i stobs dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po dang / 'dus pa chen po rin po che'i tog dang / gtsug na rin po che dang / kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par blta ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dang / gzungs zab cing rgya che ba mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa rnams mchod de bklags nas chos kyi sku'i mchod rten tshul bzhin bgyis pa'i bsod nams dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis mdo sde dang gzungs las phan yon ji skad bka' bstsal pa thams cad che ge mos 'phral du thob cing yongs su rdzogs nas mngon du gyur cig che ge mos thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas 'gro ba brgyud pa rnams su sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyi sgrib par 'gyur ba nyon mongs pa sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis 'byung ba 'di lta ste/ las kyi sgrib pa'am/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa/ lta ba'i sgrib pa'am/ mi shes pa'i sgrib pa'am/ rnam par smin pa'i sgrib pa'am/ chos kyis phongs par gyur pa'i sgrib pa la sogs pa las gang gis/

che ge mo ngan song gsum du 'chi bar 'gyur ba'am/ mi khom par skye bar 'gyur ba'am/ dkon mchog gsum mngon par mi rig cing ma gus mi 'dzin par 'gyur ba'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mi 'dzin par 'gyur ba'am/ byang chub kyi sems dang dge ba'i phyogs las nyams shing bdud kyis chom par 'gyur ba'am/ 'khor ba'i chos rnams kyis kun tu 'joms par 'gyur ba'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / yon tan gyi chos thams cad sgrub pa la mi phyogs shing mi sgrub par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i sdig pa las sna tshogs che ge mo nyid kyis bgyis pa'am/ bgyid du stsal ba'am/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa ci mchis pa thams cad ma lus pa bsal te/ gtan nas zhi zhing byang bar gyur cig sngon gyi las de lta bu'i rnam par smin pa yang rung / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur kyang rung ste/ da ltar gyi lus 'di la nad kyi rnam pa mang pos gdung ba dang / mi dang mi ma lags pa nang du bgyis shing gtses pa dang / tshe thung ba dang / sdug bsngal mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / 'khor dang yo byad mi mthun pa sbyin pa dang / bsam pa mi 'grub cing bar du gcod pa mang ba la sogs pas gnod pa dang / mi dge ba dang / bkra mi shis pa dang ngan pa dang / sdig tor bgrang ba thams cad zhi zhing gtan du mi 'byung bar gyur cig gdon bgegs dang / gnod pa bgyid pa thams cad dang bral zhing / grol nas gdon bgegs de dag byams shing zhi ba'i sems kyis sngar gnod pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa thams cad bshigs nas rang rang gi gnas su deng zhing phyin chad nam du yang gnod pa ci yang mi byed par gyur cig 'phral du yang tshe ring nad ma mchis pa dang / 'khor dang yo byad mthun zhing 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa la sogs pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig

tshe rabs thams cad du yang byang chub kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i lus dang / longs spyod dang / 'khor dang / grogs dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig theg pa chen po'i chos dang rtag tu 'phrad cing / thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / bsgoms pa'i sgo nas don mngon sum du bgyis par gyur cig dam pa'i chos ma nor bar ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams dang rgyun du 'grogs shing mnyes par bgyid par gyur cig mdor na sems can thams cad kyi don bgyi zhing 'phags pa'i lam sgrub pa la yo byad ci nas kyang mi bzung zhing thabs mkhas pa dang shes rab kyi mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che thams cad bde blag tu nyams 'og tu chud par gyur cig bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa g.yung drung gi sku sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang chen po myur du thob nas sems can thams cad srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol zhing / mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la 'god par gyur cig de'i rjes ma gzungs chab bstsal/ de'i rjes la cho ga mkhan po rnams kyis mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs bcad dang / gsal rgyal gyi tshigs bcad dang bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa zhal 'don bgyid cing bskor ba lan brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /dngos gzhi'o/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ 'phags pa gdan 'dzoms pa chen po dgongs su gsol/ deng 'dir phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa thams cad gdan 'dzoms par spyan drangs nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gzungs kyi sgo nas che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad par gsol ba'i skabs 'dir bdag cag dus ngan pa'i sems can spyod pa dman zhing ma 'tshal ba dang / bag ma mchis pa'i dbang gis lus ngag yid kyi sbyor ba nyon mongs dang 'dres pa dang / mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing ngan pa gtsang sbra ma phyed pa dang /

mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa 'khrul zhing nongs pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la bzod pa dang tshangs par gsol te/ mthol bshags shing mchis na/ thugs brtse bar dgongs shing bzod par bzhes shing / 'phral dang yun du bdag cag gi sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs par ci gnang gis bzod par gsol/ de nas dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa'i mchod rten rnams la brtan bzhugs bya ba ni me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs/ brtan bzhugs spyi 'gre la/ bye brag tu yang chos sku'i rten 'di rnams kyi ye shes pa rnams ji srid 'byung ba sogs dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor/ de nas spyan drangs pa'i 'phags pa rnams gshegs su gsol ba ni/ 'phags pa rnams kyis bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba nyam thag pa rnams kyi don mdzad cing bka' drin stsal lags te/ da dung yang bdag cag la thugs brtse bas yang dang yang du gdan 'dzoms par mdzad pas/ dgongs shing so so'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su 'gro ba mang po'i don la gshegs pa stsal du ci gnang / zhes gshegs gsol zhus nas/ zhwa yod na gyon/ ting shags kyi sgra dang me tog 'thor bas ston mchog dam pa sogs shis brjod ci shes kyi mthar me tog gi char dang / rol mo'i sgra bya ste/ mjug gi cho ga'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni lam 'di la dad cing 'dun pa dag gis nan cher bskul ba dag gi ngor mkhan po bo dhī sa twas mdzad pa'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du/ rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po'i bka' drin la brten nas bya bral dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa'o/ /'dis sems can mang po la phan par gyur cig dge'o/ /zhes rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes chen dam pas zin thor mdzad pa 'di la mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgya gzhung sbyor dngos rjes rnams ha lam tshang ba dang /

zhal skong zhu dgos rnams kyang 'di'i rgya gzhung gzhan las btus nas sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis 'phan yul bco brgyad zhabs drung mkhas grub kun dga' don grub nas lcags glang lor bstan 'gro kun dang / gang la 'brel thogs kyi sgrib sbyong tshogs gsog tu dgongs pa'i sa 'bum chen po de pa'i bla brang dang 'dabs 'byor du 'debs par mdzad skabs rjes su yi rang gi tshul du bsgrigs pa'o// //bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs klog thabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
